decisionDefinitions.CONFIRMED_FIX_REQUIRED: Direct inspection supports a defect or control gap. It must be remediated before the affected gate can pass.
decisionDefinitions.REJECTED_FALSE_POSITIVE: Direct inspection does not support a defect in the student-visible runtime, or the entry is a safeguard/quality suggestion rather than a current failure.
decisionDefinitions.NEEDS_AUTHORITATIVE_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE: The normative conclusion depends on an authoritative primary source that is cited by the reviewer but is not vendored in the reviewed repository; this board did not browse or substitute memory.

decisionCounts.deduplicationRule: Only duplicate source citations to the same underlying defect are collapsed. Related but independently remediable item defects remain separate blockers; ENG-005 and FMT-008 are the sole duplicated blocking defect.

harnessDisposition.structuralHarnessCheckMeaning: The current harness files are internally well-formed; this does not approve content or release.
harnessDisposition.reason: The current candidate-ledger editorial PASS predates these independent reports and is bound to the obsolete candidate. It must not be carried into a reconciled candidate.

overlapResolution.resolution: ENG-001/002/003 are rejected because getMock() normalizes Parts 1/2 and replaces Part 7 before guided-mocks.ts adapts questions. FMT-001 remains confirmed because this same transformation was omitted from the old candidate binding.
One confirmed blocker. ENG-005 is narrowed to Parts 5 and 6; its raw-Part-7 B/C claim is not runtime evidence. Runtime Part 7 is handled separately by FMT-007.
One item with two confirmed defects: the keyed reply is unidiomatic and the personal-preference distractor remains conversationally plausible.

Rejected for the launch runtime: normalizeIcfesMock replaces every legacy Part 7 with CURRENT_PART_SEVEN. These observations may remain archive-quality notes but cannot block the student-visible candidate.

decisions.rationale: getGuidedMockQuestions calls getMock, which remaps matching-grid to runtime Part 1 before PART_PROFILE is applied. Runtime Part 1 is vocabulary matching, not a notice task.
The runtime remaps notices-grid to Part 2 before guided adaptation. The notice profile therefore matches the effective task.
The student-visible Part 7 is replaced with CURRENT_PART_SEVEN lexical cloze content before guided adaptation. The legacy reading Part 7 cited by this finding is not the runtime Part 7.
Every generated record receives a fixed reviewedAt and editorialStatus='reviewed' regardless of the effective-content digest or board state.
decisions.requiredAction: Remove automatic certification or derive it only from a passing, hash-bound editorial release record.

decisions.rationale: The P5/P6 concentration is reproduced and material. The P7 subclaim is rejected because it was computed from replaced legacy content; runtime P7 has a different, separately confirmed deterministic cycle.
decisions.requiredAction: Rebalance complete option texts in Parts 5 and 6, preserve semantic keys, and re-review every touched item.

decisions.rationale: 'The largest Amazon country' is an imprecise nonstandard formulation; the intended claim is the country's share of the rainforest.
decisions.requiredAction: Rewrite the referent precisely and recheck the section keys.

decisions.rationale: The elliptical comparison makes the omitted object and comparison class unclear.
decisions.requiredAction: State explicitly that couples have fewer children than couples in previous generations did.

decisions.rationale: The compound subject 'passion and determination' requires plural agreement.
decisions.requiredAction: Change 'compensates' to 'compensate' and re-review the cloze.

decisions.rationale: The cited legacy Part 7 option is replaced before any product consumer receives this mock.

'A rich and varied musical history' is grammatical, idiomatic and uniquely preferable among the actual options problem/music/history/language. Adding an absent alternative such as heritage is a redesign preference, not a current ambiguity.
UNESCO heritage recognition supports significance or recognition, not necessarily worldwide popularity; the causal wording overclaims its evidence.
decisions.requiredAction: Rewrite the sentence and option set around cultural significance or provide a different premise.

decisions.rationale: The current sentence incorrectly makes weather the entity described as a city.
decisions.requiredAction: Make Medellin the referent and recheck the questions supported by the sentence.

decisions.rationale: The keyed complement 'considered some of the best quality' is not idiomatic.
decisions.requiredAction: Rewrite the key and jointly resolve the response ambiguity identified in FMT-037.

decisions.rationale: The spelling error exists only in legacy Part 7 content replaced at runtime.
The item is simple phrase localization, but the keyed answer is the only option stated by the passage. Limited discrimination is a quality preference, not an invalid key.
The stem requests an action, but none of the four declarative options supplies the required action; the current key answers why rather than what.
decisions.requiredAction: Rebuild stem and options, establish one valid key, then perform fresh item review.

decisions.rationale: The supporting sentence is visibly unidiomatic and contains an erroneous comma between subject and verb.
decisions.requiredAction: Rewrite with golfer, total strokes and across all holes; recheck all supported keys.

decisions.rationale: The passage and keyed option contain sustained non-native phrasing that degrades both stimulus validity and pedagogical feedback.
decisions.requiredAction: Rewrite the full passage and all five items, then re-adjudicate the section.

decisions.rationale: This incoherent legacy reading passage is replaced by the current shared cloze section before runtime consumption.
The nurse passage contains repeated unnatural formulations and implausible claims; the paid explanations would reproduce them as evidence.
decisions.requiredAction: Rewrite the section in natural, bounded English and re-adjudicate all seven questions.

decisions.rationale: The keyed announcement reduces a gap year to spare time/career break and omits the passage's central breadth; the option set does not offer a strong complete summary.
decisions.requiredAction: Rebuild the announcements around a faithful gap-year summary and re-adjudicate.

decisions.rationale: The cited millennial passage and key belong to legacy Part 7 and are replaced at runtime.
The student-visible Part 5 passage contains repeated unidiomatic structures even though its current key remains recoverable.
decisions.requiredAction: Rewrite the full passage and verify all seven keys against the revised wording.

decisions.rationale: The interview and distractors contain multiple conspicuous naturalness defects in student-visible content.
decisions.requiredAction: Rewrite the passage and option set, then re-adjudicate all five questions.

decisions.rationale: The camp passage is legacy Part 7 content replaced before runtime use.

All 23 recomputed runtime-effective hashes match the format report and differ from manifest content hashes because runtime remaps Parts 1/2 and replaces Part 7. The old artifact set omits those dependencies.
decisions.requiredAction: Bind raw sources, transform dependencies, guided-feedback dependencies and canonical effective-runtime hashes into the candidate digest.

decisions.rationale: This entry documents a safeguard already present ('práctica propia abreviada · 45 preguntas') rather than a current defect. Its external 55-item comparison is not needed to retain the truthful abbreviated label.

The vendored official guide says Part 2 requires recognizing the notice purpose and selecting the most appropriate place among A-C; the infographic independently says each notice must be matched to a site. The 77 listed runtime items instead ask direct purpose/action/rule/audience/meaning questions.
decisions.requiredAction: Rewrite the 77 listed items as place-choice A-C tasks or explicitly relabel them as supplemental pragmatic-notice practice outside current-format Part 2.

decisions.rationale: The vendored official guide states that Part 4 supplies three options A-C for every blank. All 184 runtime Part 4 items supply A-D.
decisions.requiredAction: Re-author as three-option A-C items and re-adjudicate distractors, or explicitly relabel this as supplemental four-option cloze practice.

decisions.rationale: The vendored official guide states that Part 5 supplies three options A-C for every question. All 161 runtime Part 5 items supply A-D.
decisions.requiredAction: Re-author as three-option A-C items and re-adjudicate distractors, or explicitly relabel this as supplemental four-option reading practice.

decisions.rationale: The vendored guide defines Part 5 as literal comprehension through paraphrase and contrasts it with Part 6 questions about author intention and general/notable aspects. Fifteen of the 35 listed items ask main idea, purpose, topic, tone or overall view and should move/rewrite; the other 20 are local contextual paraphrase/meaning items and do not require a taxonomy fix.
decisions.requiredAction: Move or rewrite the 15 general/intention/tone items for literal Part 5; retain the 20 local paraphrase items subject to the separate three-option remediation.

decisions.rationale: The shared generator deterministically assigns answer=index%4, producing the same visible A/B/C/D/A/B/C/D/A/B sequence in every mock.
decisions.requiredAction: Use a deterministic per-mock balanced permutation of complete option texts and re-review all affected items.

decisions.rationale: The reproduced runtime ledger confirms B/C contains 145/161 Part 5 keys and 100/115 Part 6 keys.
decisions.requiredAction: Rebalance complete options without changing keyed content; re-review and rehash.

decisions.rationale: The runtime remaps this matching section to Part 1, and the example answer trophy duplicates trophy already present in the A-G bank.
decisions.requiredAction: Use a distinct example answer or unique bank distractor and recheck matching integrity.

decisions.rationale: The ten records are dialog tasks rendered by sectionStyle but carry inconsistent mcq metadata.
decisions.requiredAction: Normalize their type metadata to dialog and regenerate hashes.

decisions.rationale: Direct comparison confirms 20 catalog labels do not name the executable mock themes.
decisions.requiredAction: Align each title with its runtime theme or explicitly define labels as broader collections.

decisions.rationale: Public class pages promise complete ICFES mocks, while the owned mock runtime explicitly labels these forms abbreviated. The claim is internally inconsistent even without deciding the external official profile.
decisions.requiredAction: Use 'prácticas propias abreviadas para entrenar las siete partes' wherever these 45-item forms are meant.

decisions.rationale: The visible result is already labeled estimated and the active practice explicitly states it does not predict or replace an official ICFES score. No contradictory equivalence claim was demonstrated for this runtime.

'Cooked on a griddle or pan over medium heat' is the uniquely general, idiomatic completion across both implements; 'fried' normally requires oil and is not the best completion for a griddle-or-pan construction.
Both voice communication and voice messages form ordinary noun phrases in the sentence, so lexical knowledge alone does not exclude the distractor.
decisions.requiredAction: Rewrite the context or options for one-best-answer defensibility.

decisions.rationale: Social, digital and online media are all grammatical and semantically plausible.
decisions.requiredAction: Add a uniquely social-network context or replace the competing distractors.

decisions.rationale: Natural regions is the conventional term, but natural zones remains a grammatical and semantically plausible completion with no excluding cue.
decisions.requiredAction: Add a conventional-term cue or remove zones.

decisions.rationale: Wet and dry periods can directly affect agriculture, tourism and transport; the sentence gives no crop-specific evidence.
decisions.requiredAction: Add a crop/harvest cue or replace viable alternatives.

decisions.rationale: Users and accounts both naturally complete 'millions of active social media ...'.
decisions.requiredAction: Specify people/users or rebuild the distractors.

decisions.rationale: Platform, website and channel can all be accessed to follow posts and stories.
decisions.requiredAction: Constrain the object or replace competing options.

decisions.rationale: Share and send both naturally take content with friends and family; post is also contextually viable.
decisions.requiredAction: Use a unique collocation or remove viable distractors.

decisions.rationale: Several times a day, week or hour are all grammatical and plausible frequencies.
decisions.requiredAction: Supply a daily-frequency cue or replace the other valid time units.

decisions.rationale: Tool, network and service can each describe social media for small businesses in this unconstrained sentence.
decisions.requiredAction: Use 'marketing tool' or rebuild distractors.

decisions.rationale: City, town and settlement can grammatically name a founded place; the sentence supplies no unique lexical constraint.
decisions.requiredAction: State city directly or use distractors from incompatible entity classes.

decisions.rationale: 'Attracted great attention' is the established collocation. 'Attracted great focus' is not a natural equivalent in this construction, so the key remains uniquely best.
Plays a critical role and plays a critical part are both standard collocations.
decisions.requiredAction: Remove part or rewrite for a unique answer.

decisions.rationale: Imaging can make observation possible or easier; 'without surgery' favors feasibility but does not make easy false.
decisions.requiredAction: Contrast feasibility explicitly or replace easy.

decisions.rationale: The immediate contrast explicitly discusses hours and short breaks, providing a local scheduling cue that makes time the best answer. Energy is possible in isolation but not equally supported by the following sentence.
Writing notes in class is the conventional activity explained by paraphrasing information in one's own words. Writing lists is grammatical but not comparably supported by the discourse.

The preceding sentence has already established short breaks as the study strategy; 'regular breaks' is the cohesive reference. Walks and naps are narrower optional activities not established by context.
Review and check both naturally describe reading through key points again; the sentence does not uniquely separate them.
decisions.requiredAction: Use a unique collocation or remove check.

decisions.rationale: Choose a type you might, should or would enjoy expresses three ordinary meanings; no uncertainty or condition cue selects might.
decisions.requiredAction: Add an uncertainty cue or rebuild the modal distractors.

decisions.rationale: The natural temporal completion is when, which is absent. The keyed because invents causation and is not defensible as the best answer.
decisions.requiredAction: Add and key when or rewrite the context to establish causation.

decisions.rationale: They found other beautiful paintings and they found more beautiful paintings are both grammatical and contextually plausible.
decisions.requiredAction: Add a quantity/class cue or replace more.

decisions.rationale: Early warning signs and early warning signals are both standard completions in the effective runtime content.
decisions.requiredAction: Keep one and replace the other with a non-collocating distractor.

decisions.rationale: Both surprise and a positive personal evaluation are natural replies to not having social-media accounts.
decisions.requiredAction: Add a reaction cue or replace the competing reply.

decisions.rationale: The tea preference is a coherent response, while the intended agreement option is itself unidiomatic.
decisions.requiredAction: Rewrite both the keyed response and distractors so a communicative function uniquely selects one answer.

decisions.rationale: Enthusiasm and a negative personal stance are both coherent responses to the carnival announcement.
decisions.requiredAction: Constrain the intended function or replace the negative-opinion distractor.

decisions.rationale: A favorable purchase reaction and a negative affordability judgment are both natural replies to a half-price statement.
decisions.requiredAction: Add affordability context or replace the competing judgment.

decisions.rationale: An eager acceptance and a tired refusal are both coherent responses to the event announcement absent an invitation/interest cue.
decisions.requiredAction: Constrain the speech act or replace the refusal distractor.

remediationPlan.action: Keep release, paid-detail activation and mock expansion frozen; do not create mock-24.

Redesign the editorial digest to bind all 23 raw sources, normalize-icfes-mock.ts, icfes-current-part-seven.ts, index.ts, guided-mocks.ts, guided-registry.ts, the expansion manifest and 23 canonical runtime-effective hashes.
Remove unconditional reviewed metadata and make any reviewed state resolve from an exact passing content digest.
Preserve the vendored checksum-bound ICFES guide and infographic as candidate baseline evidence; use them to drive the already completed adjudication of FMT-003 through FMT-006.

Resolve format posture: align the abbreviated practice to the frozen baseline where claimed, or relabel deviations explicitly as supplemental practice. Correct public complete-simulation claims regardless.
Remediate confirmed student-visible English defects and one-best-answer failures, beginning with mock-20:p5q3, then passage-level rewrites before dependent item rewrites.

Rebalance complete option texts in Parts 5 and 6, replace the repeated Part 7 answer cycle with a deterministic per-mock balanced permutation, fix the mock-21 example bank, and normalize metadata/catalog titles.
Regenerate all affected raw, runtime and bundle hashes; run structural tests; then commission fresh independent English and format review over every touched effective item and generated explanation.
Only after both independent reports and a new adjudication pass may a human editorial-adjudicator sign the exact reconciled candidate digest. This agent report is not that human approval.

verdict.reason: The runtime hash boundary is incomplete, one scored item has no valid answer, multiple student-visible passages/options and one-best-answer items require repair, answer-position patterns are exploitable, and the authoritative current-format baseline confirms material Part 2/4/5 mismatches.
